album: Top Five – Rachmaninoff – Piano Concerto No. 2 – The Best Recordings
excerpt: When Rachmaninoff began work on the Piano Concerto No. 2 in C minor, Op. 18 in 1900, he had not written anything of substance for nearly three years. The catastrophic premiere of his First Symphony in 1897 had left him in a deep depressive collapse, convinced he might never compose again.
